home.safetyText: Calories, macros and quantities are computed by a tested engine from official data, never invented by AI. Dangerous goals are refused, with dedicated paths for minors, pregnancy and some medical situations.

safety.engine: Calculations: Mifflin-St Jeor formula and the ANSES CIQUAL table
safety.kind: No guilt: a pizza fits in, the week adjusts gently
safety.privacy: Health data encrypted and kept separate, one-click export and deletion

what.q: How is Sorloo different from a calorie counter?
what.a: Sorloo doesn't just record: it organises. From your goal, budget, tastes and time, it builds the whole week (menus, recipes, groceries, workouts) and reorganises it when your plans change.

budget.a: Each ingredient has an average observed price and real pack sizes. The engine computes what you'll pay at the till, reuses leftover packs and deducts your pantry. Actual prices vary by shop.

family.a: Yes. The same dinner for everyone, with portions adapted to each person. Children are never put on a diet.

ai.q: What does the AI actually do?
ai.a: It understands your requests in plain language and suggests changes. Every number is recalculated by the engine, and nothing changes without your approval.

data.a: It is hosted in Europe, health data is encrypted, and you can export or delete everything at any time from your account.

price.a: The free plan covers the essentials. Premium unlocks budget, pantry, AI coach, workouts and family mode.

under_min_age.title: For ages 15 and over
under_min_age.text: Sorloo isn't suitable under 15. Talk about your diet with your parents and your doctor.

minor_no_deficit.title: No dieting under 18
minor_no_deficit.text: Your body is still growing: we offer balanced eating, without restriction. For any weight concern, talk to your doctor.

pregnancy_no_deficit.title: Pregnancy: no weight loss
pregnancy_no_deficit.text: During pregnancy we adapt intake to your needs, without restriction, and avoid foods that aren't recommended (raw fish, raw-milk cheese…). Your midwife or doctor remains your reference.

breastfeeding_mild_deficit_only.title: Breastfeeding: very gentle pace
breastfeeding_mild_deficit_only.text: While breastfeeding, weight loss is limited to 0.5 kg per week at most to protect lactation.

underweight_no_loss.title: Weight loss not recommended
underweight_no_loss.text: Your BMI is already low: we don't offer weight loss. Goal: eat well and keep your energy.

target_weight_too_low.title: Target weight too low
target_weight_too_low.text: This weight corresponds to a BMI under 18.5. We keep a safe pace, but please review this goal with a professional.

pace_too_fast.title: Pace adjusted
pace_too_fast.text: Losing more than 1% of body weight per week leads to muscle loss and regain. We limit the pace.

gain_too_fast.title: Pace adjusted
gain_too_fast.text: Beyond 0.5% per week, weight gain is mostly fat. We keep it reasonable.

medical_supervision.title: Medical situation declared
medical_supervision.text: Sorloo stays cautious (limited pace, adjusted protein if needed). Have your plan checked by your doctor or a dietitian.

eating_disorder_history.title: A plan without numbers
eating_disorder_history.text: Calories and weight are hidden and there is no restriction. If you're going through a hard time, your doctor or a local eating disorder helpline can help.

kcal_floor.title: Minimum intake
kcal_floor.text: Your calorie target never goes below a safety threshold.
